head_commit.message:
fix: Add clap attributes for proper argument parsing in linux-sandbox

Fixes #6450 - unified exec broken on linux since 0.57.0

The Linux sandbox binary was failing to parse command-line arguments
due to missing clap attributes on the `command` field. This caused
the error "unexpected argument '--sandbox-policy-cwd' found" when
unified_exec was enabled on Linux.

Added `allow_hyphen_values = true` to allow command arguments that
start with hyphens (e.g., `ls -la`) to be properly parsed as part
of the trailing command instead of being interpreted as options to
the sandbox binary itself.

Added `num_args = 1..` to make the argument requirements more
explicit for clap's parser.

These attributes ensure the argument parser correctly handles:
- The --sandbox-policy-cwd and --sandbox-policy named arguments
- The -- separator
- The trailing command arguments (which may contain flags)
